videos.description:

There’s a reason why #ChatGPT can remember your writing style and yet still forget the project decision you made yesterday. In this video I break down the 3 levels of #AI Memory: global memory, project memory, and a custom memory system.

You'll see how ChatGPT, #Claude, and Gemini retrieve information, why saved facts become incomplete or outdated, and how Claude Cowork can maintain visible files you control. By the end, you'll know which approach fits your work and when it is worth building your own AI memory system.

videos.title: Intent engineering beats prompt engineering every time
videos.description: Instead of crafting a hyper-engineered block of text, Grace gives Claude the outcome she wants and the problem she has, then lets it come back with a proposal. Her rule is that the work should never be on the person. If Claude has the right context, it should be studying you and returning strong ideas for you to react to.

A man worth tens of billions was asked the single biggest reason for his success. His answer wasn't work ethic or brains. It was where he happened to be born. Drew and I break down the luck you're dealt at birth through Warren Buffett's ovarian lottery, a tale of two babies born the same day in Norway and Sierra Leone, and an old Chinese fable about a farmer and a horse. Good luck, bad luck, who knows?
